name: Garanti BBVA
verdict: Majority owned by BBVA (85.97%), a listed Spanish bank with no controlling shareholder. Nothing found.
note: Main sponsor of the Turkish Basketball Federation's national teams since 2001; the sponsorship was extended five years at a signing ceremony on 27 January 2026 (BBVA press release, 2026-01-29), and its logo is on the front of the national team shirt, visible in the press release's photo. Owner chain: BBVA holds 85.97% (garanti-bbva-bbva-ownership); BBVA is a listed Spanish bank with no shareholder with significant influence (bbva-ownership-record). No state in the chain and no human-rights finding against the company that passes METHOD.md, so rated none.
